meta_prompt_final: You are a TSP solver. Create the SHORTEST possible tour for 20 cities. Start with nearest-neighbor: always pick the closest unvisited next city. Then eliminate ALL edge crossings by swapping intersecting paths. CRITICAL: Verify all 20 unique cities appear exactly once. After initial tour, focus on connecting geographically close cities while removing crossings. Output only the shortest valid tour in <trace>c1,c2,...,c20</trace> format. Double-check for uniqueness before submission. Compare with examples and ensure improvement. Prioritize finding the absolute shortest path by continuously optimizing connections between proximate cities while maintaining no edge crossings.
